solutions.title: Copy then carry
solutions.strategy: Copy the digits into a new buffer and perform grade-school carry propagation from right to left.

timeComplexity.explanation: Copying and carry propagation each touch at most n digits.

spaceComplexity.explanation: The output buffer stores a copy of the input digits before returning the incremented number.

solutions.title: Mutate from the end
solutions.strategy: Walk from the last digit leftward, changing trailing nines to zero and returning as soon as a digit can be incremented.

timeComplexity.explanation: The worst case scans all digits when every position carries.

spaceComplexity.explanation: The input array is reused; only the all-nine overflow case needs a new returned array of length n + 1.
